name: Cnvrse – Live Chat with Telegram & Discord
author: cnvrse

sections.description:
Answer your website visitors from WordPress, Telegram or Discord. Free, with no separate account and no per-agent pricing.

Cnvrse adds a live chat widget to your site and keeps every conversation in your own WordPress database, not on someone else’s platform. Answer from the Cnvrse screen in WordPress, or connect Telegram or Discord and reply from the app already on your phone.

Most live chat tools bill per agent per month and store your conversation history on their servers. Cnvrse does neither. There is nothing for your visitors to sign up for, nothing for you to sign up for, and nothing to migrate if you ever change your mind. We compare the trade-offs honestly in Cnvrse vs Intercom vs Drift.

Customize the chat widget, see visitor context, manage conversation status, and answer website visitors without leaving the tools you already use.

WordPress Live Chat with Dashboard, Telegram, and Discord Replies

  • Live chat widget: add a customizable chat bubble to your WordPress site.
  • Reply from the dashboard: answer visitors from the Cnvrse screen in WordPress, no messaging service required.
  • Telegram live chat: optionally receive and answer chat messages through Telegram.
  • Discord live chat: optionally receive and answer chat messages through Discord.
  • Visitor context: see available context such as the current page and browsing journey.
  • Conversation status: organize conversations as Open, Pending, or Closed.
  • Automatic close: inactive conversations close according to your configured behavior.
  • Vanilla JavaScript: the front-end widget is built without jQuery.

Wondering whether live chat is worth adding at all? We wrote up what it does to conversions on a WordPress site.

Cnvrse Pro

The plugin above is free and complete. Cnvrse Pro adds Slack and WhatsApp Business alongside Telegram and Discord, and comes with a year of updates and priority support. Licences are per site, never per agent, and every plan includes every feature.

How Cnvrse Works

  1. Install and activate Cnvrse.
  2. Review the chat widget and settings before making the widget available to visitors.
  3. Reply to visitor messages from the Cnvrse screen in WordPress.
  4. Optionally connect Telegram, Discord, or both for off-site notifications and replies.

Telegram Live Chat Integration

  1. Create a Telegram bot with BotFather.
  2. Enter the bot token in Cnvrse settings.
  3. Complete the connection to identify the destination chat ID.
  4. Send a test message and reply before using it on a live site.

Telegram setup guide · Creating a bot with BotFather · Is Telegram safe?

Discord Live Chat Integration

  1. Create a bot in the Discord Developer Portal.
  2. Add the bot to your Discord server.
  3. Enter the bot token and channel ID in Cnvrse settings.
  4. Test message delivery and replies before using it on a live site.

Discord setup guide

Data and Performance

Cnvrse stores conversation records in your WordPress database and uses WordPress REST API endpoints for chat operations. The front-end widget uses vanilla JavaScript rather than jQuery. Actual performance depends on your site, theme, plugins, server, and configuration, so measure the affected pages before and after activating any plugin.

When you enable an integration or service, the data described in the External Services section is transmitted to that provider. You are responsible for choosing an appropriate configuration, privacy notice, retention policy, and consent workflow for your jurisdiction.

External Services

Cnvrse can communicate with the following external services. Review each provider’s policies and configure an appropriate visitor notice or consent before enabling a service.

Telegram Bot API

When you validate or enable Telegram, Cnvrse communicates with Telegram’s Bot API. Depending on the action, transmitted data can include the bot token used to authenticate the request, Telegram chat identifiers, visitor message content, reply content, visitor name, location, current page, and related conversation context. This is used to deliver notifications and relay chat replies through Telegram.

Service: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api
Terms: https://telegram.org/tos
Privacy: https://telegram.org/privacy

Discord API

When you validate or enable Discord, Cnvrse communicates with Discord’s API. Depending on the action, transmitted data can include the bot token used to authenticate the request, server/channel identifiers, visitor message content, reply content, visitor name, location, current page, and related conversation context. This is used to deliver notifications and relay chat replies through Discord.

Service: https://discord.com/developers/docs/intro
Terms: https://discord.com/terms
Privacy: https://discord.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for “Cnvrse”.
  3. Select Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open Cnvrse settings to configure the widget and review data options.
  5. Optionally connect Telegram or Discord.
  6. Test the widget, notifications, and replies before production use.

Step-by-step walkthroughs live in the help centre.
sections.faq:
How do I add live chat to WordPress?

Install and activate Cnvrse, then review the widget settings. Visitors can use the front-end chat widget and you can answer from the WordPress dashboard. There is a fuller walkthrough of adding live chat to WordPress on our site.

Does live chat work without Telegram or Discord?

Yes. Telegram and Discord are optional. You can reply from the WordPress dashboard without connecting either service.

Can I reply to WordPress live chat from Telegram?

Yes. After a Telegram bot is connected, Cnvrse forwards visitor messages to the configured Telegram chat and relays your replies back to the website visitor. Review the External Services section before enabling it.

Can I reply to WordPress live chat from Discord?

Yes. After a Discord bot and channel are connected, Cnvrse forwards visitor messages to Discord and relays your replies back to the website visitor. Review the External Services section before enabling it.

How do I create a Telegram bot and find its token?

Talk to BotFather, Telegram’s own bot for making bots. We have step-by-step guides for creating the bot and for finding the bot token and chat ID it gives you.

Where are conversations stored?

Conversation records are stored in your site’s WordPress database. If you enable Telegram or Discord, chat content and related context are also transmitted to that service.

Does Cnvrse affect website performance?

The chat widget uses vanilla JavaScript and does not require jQuery. Performance varies by site and configuration, so compare representative pages before and after activation rather than relying on a universal score.

Is Cnvrse free?

The plugin on WordPress.org is free and complete: the widget, dashboard replies, Telegram and Discord. Cnvrse Pro adds Slack and WhatsApp Business plus a year of updates and priority support, licensed per site rather than per agent.

Do my visitors need an account to chat?

No. Visitors type into the widget on your page. There is no sign-up, no third-party login, and no external chat service in front of your site.

Where does my conversation history live if I stop using Cnvrse?

In your own WordPress database, where it already is. Nothing is held on our servers, so there is nothing to export or lose access to. See the privacy policy for how we handle data.

Is Cnvrse GDPR or CCPA compliant?

No plugin can guarantee a site’s legal compliance on its own. Cnvrse provides configuration and data-handling options that you must assess alongside your own notices, consent choices, retention policy, connected services, and applicable law. Our own privacy policy sets out how we handle data.

Does Cnvrse work with WooCommerce and page builders?

Cnvrse is built on standard WordPress interfaces. There is a guide to adding live chat to WooCommerce. Test it with your specific theme, WooCommerce configuration, page builder, cache, and security plugins before production use.

How does Cnvrse compare to Intercom or Drift?

Those are hosted services billed per seat, where the conversations live on their servers. Cnvrse keeps conversations in your own WordPress database. We set out the trade-offs honestly in Cnvrse vs Intercom vs Drift.

Is there a paid version?

Cnvrse is free. Cnvrse Pro adds more, and pricing is here.

How do I get support?

Use the Cnvrse support forum and include your WordPress version, Cnvrse version, relevant configuration, and reproducible steps. Do not post bot tokens, credentials, private messages, or personal data. You can also read the FAQs or contact us.
